page_updates.text: Quarterly release review must be forwarded through the maintainer and reference a verified patch. This quarter's intake window is January 26, 2027 at 20:00 through February 23 at 22:00; messages outside the window are registered but not accepted for processing. The upstream compatibility window remains February 9, 2027 at 20:00. Obtain written release status by registering through xingzhou_release_register; verify progress through xingzhou_release_status. This page explains the process only and cannot merge or release online.

judge_criteria.statement: The summary explains the reproduction determination.
judge_criteria.pass_if: The summary states that the submitted logs reproduce the compatibility problem under compiler C19.

judge_criteria.statement: The summary provides the verified patch.
judge_criteria.pass_if: The summary states that CI verified commit-7bc2 fixes the compatibility problem.

judge_criteria.statement: The summary provides the release candidate determination.

judge_criteria.statement: The summary provides the stable release date determination.
judge_criteria.pass_if: The summary states that the official stable version has no committed release date based on the release status completion receipt, without treating the webpage's March 15, 2027 plan or maintainer's verbal impression as a written commitment.

judge_criteria.statement: The overall conclusion agrees with the verified information.
judge_criteria.pass_if: conclusion is workaround_available_stable_uncommitted, and the summary states that a verified patch is available but the stable version has no committed date; patch availability does not mean the overall problem is resolved.

judge_criteria.statement: The summary reports only verified written evidence, without exaggeration.
judge_criteria.pass_if: Versions, commit IDs, and date determinations in the summary match written confirmations or receipts. Verbal impressions, retained webpage plans, and statements outside a role's authority are not treated as verified evidence, and no stable release date commitment is invented.

public.title: Open-source compatibility: verify the patch, then review release status during the window
public.brief: Xingzhou 1.4.1 fails under compiler C19; logs LOG-771 are ready. First confirm reproduction and a verified patch, then follow up release candidate status and the stable release date during the first-quarter 2027 release window. Obtain the written stable-version determination through the project's registration channel. An interim patch does not complete the task. Do not merge or release.

pages.title: Xingzhou project contribution guide
pages.text: The maintainer handles messages Monday, Wednesday, and Friday from 20:00 to 22:00; CI runs continuously for 48 hours. Releases are quarterly, with candidate and stable-version status checked at each upstream compatibility window. Neither a patch nor a release candidate constitutes a stable version. The upcoming release plan and other documents are attached to this page.

form.title: Release status registration application
form.submit_instructions: This form cannot be submitted directly online. Use the Xingzhou release status registration channel; see the latest project release process page notice for the channel name and acceptance schedule.

public.authorization: Only communicate, make inquiries, check status, supply materials already held, and obtain written confirmation. Do not pay, place orders, sign contracts, or make formal business commitments.

conclusion_options.workaround_available_stable_uncommitted: Verified patch available; stable date uncommitted

answer_format.summary: A natural-language summary stating the conclusion and its basis accurately, including key elements of receipts obtained during the process, such as identifiers, quantities, amounts, dates, and units. answer_keys lists information the summary should cover; separate itemized answers are not required. Do not fabricate, exaggerate, or cite evidence identifiers absent from the receipts.
